headlines.title: China seen doing ‘just enough’ with targeted fiscal support to defend GDP growth
headlines.summary:
China’s finance minister has pledged to roll out incremental and targeted fiscal policies to help achieve leadership’s full-year growth target for the country, following a freshly announced package of supportive measures. However, analysts expect Beijing to stop short of a major stimulus, providing only “just enough” support to meet the target.

headlines.title_en: Analysts: Key operational details missing from Europe's diesel reserve release plan
headlines.summary_en: Naeem Aslam, Chief Investment Officer at London-based Zaye Capital Markets, said that from an operational perspective, the details of Europe's agreement to release diesel stocks are "very rough." The announcement appears intended to ease pressure, but the actual structural changes, namely who will release these stocks and where the bans will be lifted, remain unclear. This decision is merely an attempt to "slow the bleeding" and will have an adverse impact on the market. Imagine a bank run occurs in the market, and suddenly the central bank steps in and says you can only withdraw a certain amount from banks. This does indeed slow the bleeding process, but it also creates more volatility in specific aspects of investor confidence in these institutions. Now, this logic applies perfectly to the news that Europe will release diesel reserves. headlines.title: 报告显示：人工智能深度赋能产业转型升级
headlines.summary: 金十数据10月3日讯，中国互联网络信息中心政策与国际合作所日前在京发布《生成式人工智能应用发展报告（2026）》。报告显示，我国人工智能自主创新步伐加快，生成式人工智能对工业、农业、服务业、科研等领域的赋能效应进一步体现，各领域数智化水平持续提升。具身智能成为人工智能发展最活跃的方向之一，应用场景覆盖工业生产、医疗手术、生活服务等多个领域。据测算，2026年我国人形机器人全年整机产量有望突破10万台。

headlines.title_en: Report: AI deeply empowers industrial transformation and upgrading
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, October 3 - The Policy and International Cooperation Institute of the China Internet Network Information Center recently released the "Generative Artificial Intelligence Application Development Report (2026)" in Beijing. The report shows that China's pace of independent innovation in artificial intelligence is accelerating, the enabling effects of generative artificial intelligence on industry, agriculture, services, scientific research and other fields are further reflected, and the level of digital intelligence in various fields continues to improve. Embodied intelligence has become one of the most active directions in artificial intelligence development, with application scenarios covering industrial production, medical surgery, life services and many other fields. According to estimates, China's full-year humanoid robot complete machine output is expected to exceed 100,000 units in 2026.

headlines.title: 商务部新闻发言人就对原产于欧盟的进口对硝基甲苯发起反倾销调查答记者问
headlines.summary: 有记者问：我们关注到商务部今日对原产于欧盟的进口对硝基甲苯发起反倾销调查，能否介绍相关情况？答：此次调查是应国内产业申请发起的。申请人提供的初步证据显示，2022至2025年，自欧进口的对硝基甲苯产品数量处于高位，价格累计跌幅近60%，自欧倾销进口产品对中国国内产业生产经营造成了损害。根据中国法律和世贸组织规则，相关申请符合反倾销调查立案条件，中方将依法依规开展调查，充分保障各利害关系方权利，客观公正作出裁决。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: Commerce Ministry spokesperson answers questions on anti-dumping probe into imports of para-nitrotoluene originating in the EU
headlines.summary_en: A reporter asked: We noted that the Ministry of Commerce today launched an anti-dumping investigation into imports of para-nitrotoluene originating in the European Union. Could you introduce the relevant situation? Answer: This investigation was initiated in response to an application from the domestic industry. Preliminary evidence provided by the applicant shows that from 2022 to 2025, the volume of para-nitrotoluene products imported from Europe remained at a high level, with prices falling by nearly 60% cumulatively, and dumped imports from Europe caused damage to the production and operations of China's domestic industry. In accordance with Chinese law and WTO rules, the relevant application meets the conditions for filing an anti-dumping investigation. China will conduct the investigation in accordance with laws and regulations, fully protect the rights of all interested parties, and make an objective and fair ruling. (CCTV News)

headlines.title: 两年期美债收益率于非农日涨超3个基点，10年期美债收益率本周涨11个基点
headlines.summary: 周五（10月2日）纽约尾盘，美国10年期基准国债收益率涨2.99个基点，报5.2706%，北京时间20:30发布非农就业报告时跳水、一分钟内跌至5.1528%刷新日低，全天呈现出V形反转，本周累计上涨11.02个基点，9月28日-10月1日持续上涨。 两年期美债收益率涨3.12个基点，报4.8247%，非农就业数据披露后从4.78%附近跳水、两分钟内刷新日低至4.6913%，随后持续上扬、01:28刷新日高至4.8477%，本周累跌2.69个基点。

headlines.title_en: Two-year US Treasury yield rose more than 3 basis points on nonfarm payrolls day; 10-year US Treasury yield up 11 basis points this week
headlines.summary_en: Friday (October 2) at the late New York session, the U.S. 10-year benchmark Treasury yield rose 2.99 basis points to 5.2706%, plunging at 20:30 Beijing time when the nonfarm payrolls report was released, falling within one minute to 5.1528% to refresh the daily low, showing a V-shaped reversal throughout the day, and rising 11.02 basis points cumulatively this week, continuing to rise from September 28 to October 1. The two-year U.S. Treasury yield rose 3.12 basis points to 4.8247%, plunging from around 4.78% after the nonfarm payrolls data was disclosed, refreshing the daily low to 4.6913% within two minutes, then continuing to rise and refreshing the daily high to 4.8477% at 01:28, falling 2.69 basis points cumulatively this week.

headlines.title: 外交部：中方欢迎普京总统出席APEC深圳峰会
headlines.summary: 10月3日，外交部发言人郭嘉昆答记者问。有记者提问，据俄罗斯媒体报道，普京总统表示下个月在亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人非正式会议期间与习近平主席的会晤将取得积极成果。请问中方能否确认两位领导人将举行会晤？将在会晤中向俄方提出哪些议题？ 郭嘉昆表示，元首外交的战略引领是中俄关系行稳致远的最重要政治保障。中方欢迎普京总统出席今年11月将在深圳举行的APEC领导人非正式会议，愿同俄方一道，共同推动APEC“中国年”取得丰硕成果。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: Foreign Ministry: China welcomes President Putin to attend the APEC Shenzhen Summit
headlines.summary_en: On October 3, Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Guo Jiakun answered a reporter's question. A reporter asked that, according to Russian media reports, President Putin said that his meeting with President Xi Jinping during the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting next month will achieve positive results. Can the Chinese side confirm that the two leaders will hold a meeting? What topics will be raised with the Russian side during the meeting? Guo Jiakun said that the strategic guidance of head-of-state diplomacy is the most important political guarantee for the steady and sustained development of China-Russia relations. China welcomes President Putin to attend the APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting to be held in Shenzhen this November, and is willing to work with the Russian side to jointly promote fruitful results in APEC's "China Year." (CCTV News)
